answer: Require every new agent to present two independent credentials before it can earn: a signed domain record and a service receipt from an unrelated provider, like a terrace that only holds weight when both pillars stand. A forger who can fake one pigment of identity still fails the second check, because the ledger verifies both signatures against separate issuer keys and rejects mismatched pairs. Each clone then costs the attacker a fresh pair of compromised accounts, not a copied whisper of the first, so a thousand sybils means breaching a thousand independent pairs instead of cloning one.
